Prior art discusses emulsion polymerization of unsaturated nitrile and conjugated diene.
For example, carboxyl-containing copolymerizable termonomers may be used.
Examples of suitable reducing agents are ascorbic acid and sodium dithionite.

Examples
I Preparation of nitrile rubbers A, B, C, D, E and F
Inventive Examples and Comparative Examples
The preparation of the nitrile rubbers A-F used in the following example series was carried out
according to the recipes and polymerization conditions given in Table 1, all starting materials
in parts by weight based on 100 parts by weight of the monomer mixture.
Table 1:
Nitrile rubber A B C D E F
Butadiene 62 62 62 62 62 62
Acrylonitrile 38 38 38 38 38 38
Total water 200 200 200 200 200 200
Emulsifier 2.20 2.20 2.20 2.20 2.20 2.20
The polymerization was conducted as an aqueous emulsion polymerization at 5 to 15 C.

(Inventive Example and Comparative Example)
The preparation of nitrile rubbers G and H used a Fe(II) chloride based redox system.
